common.error.title: That did not work
common.error.body: Something went wrong on our side. Your work is safe. Try again in a moment.
home.purpose: A place to raise problems that affect a community and work on them in the open. This app is an early preview.
home.health.heading: Connection
home.health.loading: Checking the connection to the server
home.health.ok: Connected to the server. Everything is working.
home.health.degraded: Connected to the server, but some parts are not working yet. {part, select, db {The database is not responding.} other {Please try again soon.}}
home.health.error: We could not reach the server. Check that it is running, then try again.
profile.welcome.title: You are already good at something
profile.welcome.body: You do not need to be an expert in problems. You are already good at something. Tell us what, and we will show you the few public problems you can move.
profile.welcome.skip: Not now, show me the plain list
profile.know.title: What you know
profile.know.body: Pick the kinds of work or knowledge you have. No job titles and no employers.
profile.give.title: What you can give
profile.give.time: Time you could give each month
profile.give.time.lots: A day or more each week
profile.places.title: Places you are connected to
profile.places.body: Pick wide areas only, such as a city or region. They are kept private on this phone.
profile.places.check: Check this place on this phone
profile.places.noAdd: We could not be sure, so no place was added. You can try again.
profile.places.privacy: Your position never leaves this phone. Nothing about the check is sent to CAN.
profile.about.title: Languages, what affects you, causes
profile.about.topics: Topics come from the same list public problems use.
profile.review.title: Your profile
profile.review.body: This is everything in your profile. It is stored on this phone and nowhere else.
profile.review.empty: Your profile is empty. You will see the plain list of public problems.
profile.review.exportNote: The file is yours. Anyone who has it can read it.
profile.review.delete.confirm: Delete everything in your profile from this phone? This cannot be undone.
profile.review.deleted: Your profile was deleted from this phone.
profile.review.lost: If you lose this phone without a saved file, the profile is gone. That is by design.
profile.review.importPaste: Paste the contents of your saved file here
profile.review.importBad: That file is not a CAN profile. Nothing was changed.
profile.review.imported: Your profile was loaded onto this phone.
profile.review.saveError: Your profile could not be saved on this phone.
common.error.generic: Something went wrong. Your work is safe. Try again.
common.offline.banner: You are offline. You can read what is already loaded. Changes will wait until you reconnect.
common.validation.tooLong: That is {count, number} characters. The most is {max, number}.
nav.label: Main
emergency.notice: If someone is in danger, contact your local emergency number.
session.expired.title: You were signed out
session.expired.body: Your draft is saved on this device. Sign in again to carry on.
form.progress.fields: {done, number} of {required, number} needed fields answered
form.field.unknown: I do not know this yet
form.field.unsupported: This form has a field type this app version cannot show. Your other answers are safe. Update the app to answer it.
form.field.unsupportedBlocks: You cannot submit until that field can be answered.
form.field.slot: This part has its own editor, which is not available in this screen yet.
form.error.url: Use a web address that starts with https://
form.error.tooShort: That is {count, number} characters. The least is {min, number}.
form.error.unknownWhy: Say what would help find out
match.title: Problems you can move
match.intro: A short list from your profile. It ends here.
match.why.place: You are connected to {place}. This problem is in {place}.
match.why.topic: You care about {topic}. This problem is about {topic}.
match.plainList: See every public problem, newest activity first
match.plainList.hide: Back to problems you can move
match.empty.title: Nothing fits right now
match.empty.body: No public problem matches your profile at the moment. The plain list shows every problem.
match.noProfile: Add a profile to see problems you can move, or read the plain list.
match.local: Matched on this phone. Nothing about you was sent.
match.notify.off: Notices are off. Open this page when you like.
match.error: The public problems could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
list.title: Problems
list.order: Sorted by date published. Engagement is not used.
list.empty.title: No problems here yet
list.empty.body: Be the first to describe one.
list.empty.filtered: Nothing matches these filters. Change the place, stage or search, or clear them.
list.error: The problems could not be loaded. Your filters are kept. Try again.
detail.bylineSeed: Seed problem in {place}. No person started it.
detail.seed.explain: This problem was written by the project to start the platform. Its evidence is synthetic and is shown so you can see how the work looks.
detail.transitional: Transitional stewardship: only the founder approves this policy for now.
detail.error: This problem could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
detail.notFound.title: Not found
detail.tombstone.on: It was taken out of view on {date, date, medium}.
detail.tombstone.kept: Replies and decisions that refer to it are kept.
detail.duplicate: This problem was marked as a duplicate of another.
detail.history.error: The history could not be loaded.
tombstone.title: This item is no longer shown
tombstone.notFound: We could not find this. It may never have existed, or it may not be visible to you.
auth.signup.title: Create your account
auth.signup.body: Writing is by invitation for now. Reading needs no account.
auth.signup.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
auth.invite.label: Invite code
auth.invite.invalid: That invite code did not work. Check it and try again.
auth.email.label: Email
auth.email.invalid: That does not look like an email address.
auth.email.privacy: We keep your email encrypted and never show it to anyone.
auth.age.label: I am 18 or older
auth.age.required: Please confirm you are 18 or older to go on.
auth.code.title: Check your email
auth.code.body: Enter the 6 digit code we sent you.
auth.code.label: 6 digit code
auth.code.resent: If that address can sign in, we sent a new code. It lasts 10 minutes.
auth.code.invalid: That code is not right, or it has expired. Check it or ask for a new one.
auth.code.noEmail: We no longer have your address on this screen. Start again to get a code.
auth.signin.title: Sign in
auth.signin.body: We will email you a 6 digit code. No password needed.
auth.signin.noAccount: No account yet? You can read everything without one.
auth.code.sentGeneric: If that address can sign in, we sent a code. It lasts 10 minutes.
auth.code.resendIn: You can ask for a new code in {seconds, number} seconds.
auth.rateLimited: Too many tries. Please wait {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} and try again.
onboard.title: Welcome
onboard.handle.body: Your public name is {handle}. Your email is never shown.
onboard.handle.regenNote: You can change it once, until you publish something. After that it stays the same.
onboard.handle.regenUsed: Your name can be changed once, and that is done. It stays the same now.
onboard.promise: Here we work on shared public problems, not on people.
onboard.profile: Optional: set up a profile on this device to see problems you can move.
